title: The all-new 2021 Volkswagen ID.4 electric SUV (Volkswagen of America launch release, reproduced on ConceptCarz)
notes: Relays the VW US launch release: 82 kWh gross, 125 kW DC (5-80% in about 38 min), 11 kW onboard charger, CCS socket, 12 modules of 288 pouch cells. Net capacity and voltage not stated.
